name: picasso-template
description: The picasso default template: Vite + React + TS strict + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, every picasso gate pre-wired. First adapter at the stack seam.

scripts.render:gate: npm run build && node scripts/render-report.mjs && node tools/console-ratchet.mjs --report reports/console-report.json --baseline baselines/console-baseline.json && node tools/a11y-ratchet.mjs --violations reports/a11y-report.json --baseline baselines/a11y-baseline.json --render-failures reports/render-failures.json --render-baseline baselines/render-baseline.json
scripts.selftest: node tools/task-state.mjs --self-test && node tools/task-coverage.mjs --self-test && node tools/lint-budget.mjs --self-test && node tools/ratchet.mjs --self-test && node tools/a11y-ratchet.mjs --self-test && node tools/console-ratchet.mjs --self-test && node tools/size-budget.mjs --self-test && node tools/gate-registry.mjs --self-test && node tools/gate-registry.mjs && node tools/task-state.mjs metrics
